- **The headline:** on the FB event cover and its safe-zone check artboard, "STOPKY / NELŽOU" now reads clearly larger. It still sits above the yellow bottom band.

The tool only gives a zoomed-out view of the whole canvas, so I could confirm each artboard renders but not check fine detail. The one thing still worth checking by eye in the studio is whether the bigger headline stays inside the red mobile-crop guides on `fb-event-safe`.
